info.title: webitel-dcctl API
info.description: Datacenter switching for Webitel. Errors are `Error` objects; tell them apart by `id`, not by the HTTP status.

tags.name: ArbiterService
tags.description:
Storage of the arbiter voter, served by `webitel-dcctl arbiter` over gRPC
with mTLS only.

An arbiter without `records/state` is uninitialized. Until a dcctl
instance creates `records/state` with allow_missing, every other call
fails with FAILED_PRECONDITION, reason ARBITER_UNINITIALIZED.

tags.name: DatacenterService
tags.description:
Datacenters and the actions on them. Every action creates an operation and
returns it; with validate_only it returns the checks and the plan without
creating anything, or the error the real request would get. An action on a
datacenter that is not in the config fails with NOT_FOUND, reason
DATACENTER_NOT_FOUND, before any check runs.

tags.name: JournalService
tags.description: Journal of operations, system actions and alarms.

google.protobuf.NullValue.description:
Represents a JSON `null`.

`NullValue` is a sentinel, using an enum with only one value to represent
the null value for the `Value` type union.

A field of type `NullValue` with any value other than `0` is considered
invalid. Most ProtoJSON serializers will emit a `Value` with a `null_value`
set as a JSON `null` regardless of the integer value, and so will round trip
to a `0` value.

 - NULL_VALUE: Null value.

confirmation.description:
Confirmation field that accepts the failure, set when effect is CONFIRM:
`isolation`, `not_max_lsn` or `max_discard_bytes`.

datacenter.description: Datacenter the check is about, when it is about one.

facts.description:
Data the result is based on. Keys depend on the check. Numbers inside
are JSON numbers, unlike int64 fields of the API, which are JSON strings.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Check.description: Result of one preflight, verify or informational check.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Check.Effect.description:
What a failed check does to the action.

 - EFFECT_UNSPECIFIED: Informational and verify checks.
 - BLOCK: Failure rejects the action with PREFLIGHT_FAILED.
 - WARN_ONLY: Failure is reported as WARN and goes to the operation warnings.
 - CONFIRM: Failure requires the confirmation named in `confirmation`.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Check.Result.description:
Check result.

 - RESULT_UNSPECIFIED: Not set.
 - PASS: The condition holds.
 - FAIL: The condition does not hold, or data to evaluate it is missing.
 - WARN: The condition does not hold, the action is not blocked.
 - SKIP: The check does not apply to the situation.

isolation.description: The old primary is isolated (failover, resume into FORCED mode, resolve).

not_max_lsn.description: The failover target does not have the largest received LSN.

max_discard_bytes.description:
Upper bound of diverged or lagging WAL the operator agrees to discard.
The action is rejected with CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED when the actual amount
is larger.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Confirmation.description:
Operator confirmations of risky effects. A confirmation that does not apply
to the current situation is ignored and not stored in the operation.

name.description:
Resource name: `datacenters/{datacenter}`, where `{datacenter}` is the
Consul datacenter name.

health.description: Whether the datacenter works in its role.

health_reasons.description: Why health is DEGRADED or DOWN.

needs_recovery.description:
The datacenter is in needs_recovery of the effective state. Set even
when state shows a higher-priority value.

info_checks.description:
Informational checks `info.*`. They do not affect state, health,
alarms or preflight. GetDatacenter only.

observer.description: Instance whose view this is. GetDatacenter only.

observe_time.description: When the observer's last collection cycle finished. GetDatacenter only.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Datacenter.description:
A datacenter as seen by the instance that answers. ListDatacenters and
Status fill the summary fields; the observer, members, nodes, jobs and
info checks are filled by GetDatacenter only.

consul_datacenter.description:
Consul datacenter reported by the server. Differs from the
datacenter name on a misconfiguration.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Datacenter.Health.description:
Whether the datacenter works in its role.

 - HEALTH_UNSPECIFIED: Not set.
 - OK: Works in its role.
 - DEGRADED: Works with problems listed in health_reasons.
 - DOWN: Does not work in its role.
 - UNKNOWN: Unreachable, or a source is missing to tell.

not_ready_nodes.description: Nodes that are not ready. GetDatacenter only.

job_counts.description: Number of managed jobs in each state.

stages.description: Managed jobs by stage. GetDatacenter only.

allocation_counts.description:
Number of allocations by Nomad ClientStatus, for example
`running`, `pending`, `failed`.

healthy_node_count.description: System job: nodes with a healthy allocation.

expected_node_count.description: System job: nodes expected to run it.

missing_nodes.description: System job: nodes without a healthy allocation and why.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Datacenter.Nomad.Job.description: Managed job: a Nomad job with `meta.dcctl_stage`.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Datacenter.Nomad.Job.St.description:
Job state.

 - STATE_UNSPECIFIED: Not set.
 - STOPPED: Stopped.
 - STOPPING: Stop requested, allocations are still pending, running or
unknown.
 - HEALTHY: Running and healthy.
 - UNHEALTHY: Not stopped and not healthy, including while starting.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Datacenter.Nomad.Job.Ty.description:
Nomad job type.

 - TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Not set.
 - SERVICE: service.
 - SYSTEM: system.
 - BATCH: batch.
 - SYSBATCH: sysbatch.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Datacenter.Nomad.JobCou.description: Number of managed jobs in each state.

reason.description: Why the node is not ready.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Datacenter.Nomad.Node.description: Nomad node that does not run managed jobs normally.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Datacenter.Nomad.Node.R.description:
Why the node is not ready.

 - REASON_UNSPECIFIED: Not set.
 - DRAINING: The node is draining.
 - DOWN: The node is down.
 - INELIGIBLE: The node is ineligible for scheduling.

job_counts.description: Number of jobs of the stage in each state.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Datacenter.Nomad.Unmana.description: Job without `meta.dcctl_stage`; dcctl does not manage it.

upstream_datacenter.description: Datacenter whose nodes standby_cluster_host points at.

lag_bytes.description:
Lag of the datacenter behind the active primary. Approximate between
clusters.

divergence_lsn.description:
Point where the timeline diverged from the active leader, as an LSN
like `0/5000060`. Set only when the datacenter diverged.

divergence_bytes.description: WAL written after the divergence point.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Datacenter.Patroni.description:
Patroni cluster of the datacenter (warm_standby) or the part of the
cluster in it (stretch).

error.description: Why the REST API does not answer.

patroni_state.description:
Patroni member state as reported, for example `running`,
`streaming`.

replication_state.description: Replication state as reported, for example `streaming`.

usable.description: The member can be used by dcctl.

unusable_reason.description: Why the member cannot be used.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Datacenter.Patroni.Role.description:
Role of a Patroni member.

 - ROLE_UNSPECIFIED: Not set or not reported.
 - PRIMARY: Primary.
 - STANDBY_LEADER: Leader of a standby cluster.
 - REPLICA: Replica.
 - SYNC_STANDBY: Synchronous standby.
 - QUORUM_STANDBY: Quorum standby.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Datacenter.Patroni.Unus.description:
Why a member cannot be used.

 - UNUSABLE_REASON_UNSPECIFIED: The member is usable.
 - VERSION: Patroni is older than 4.1.0.
 - TLS: The REST API has no valid TLS certificate.
 - UNREACHABLE: The REST API does not answer.

location.description: Current WAL position of a primary.

received_location.description: Last received WAL position of a replica.

replayed_location.description: Last replayed WAL position of a replica.

replay_time.description: Commit time of the last replayed transaction.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Datacenter.Patroni.Xlog.description: WAL positions of a member, in bytes.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Datacenter.State.description:
Role of the datacenter in coordination. The first matching value in
this order wins.

 - STATE_UNSPECIFIED: Not set.
 - UNREACHABLE: No source of the datacenter is reachable.
 - UNINITIALIZED: No voter has the dcctl state.
 - ACTIVE: The active datacenter of the effective state.
 - SPLIT_BRAIN: An inactive datacenter runs a managed job that is not stopped.
 - DB_SPLIT: warm_standby: the Patroni leader of an inactive datacenter is primary.
 - STALE: The voter of the datacenter has an older generation.
 - NEEDS_RECOVERY: Waits for recovery after a failover.
 - STANDBY: Healthy standby.

user.description: Basic auth user name. Empty for system actions.

address.description: Client address as seen by the instance that accepted the request.

instance.description: Instance that accepted the request, or that observed the event.

system.description: dcctl acted by itself: fencing, generation alignment, alarms.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Initiator.description: Who started an operation or caused a journal entry.

node.description: Consul node name of the instance.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Instance.description: A dcctl instance: one `webitel-dcctl serve` process.

name.description:
Resource name: `journalEntries/<time>-<id>`, the same `<time>-<id>` as
the KV key.

initiator.description: Who caused the entry. For alarms, the instance that observed it.

params.description:
Action parameters: request body, generation before and after, mode.
Numbers inside are JSON numbers, unlike int64 fields of the API, which
are JSON strings.

result.description: Outcome. For alarms: raised by severity, or cleared.

error.description: Error when the result is ERROR.

webitel.dcctl.v1.JournalEntry.description:
Journal record. Stored as protojson in the Consul KV key
`dcctl/journal/<time>-<id>` of every reachable datacenter, where `<time>`
is the creation time in UTC as 23 digits (yyyymmddhhmmss and
nanoseconds). Field names are part of that KV format: renaming a field
breaks entries written by older instances. Holds no secrets.

webitel.dcctl.v1.JournalEntry.Result.description:
Outcome of the recorded action.

 - RESULT_UNSPECIFIED: Not set.
 - OK: Succeeded, or an alarm cleared.
 - WARNING: Succeeded with warnings, or a WARNING alarm raised.
 - ERROR: Failed, or a CRITICAL alarm raised.

webitel.dcctl.v1.JournalEntry.SystemActi.description:
Action dcctl takes by itself, without an operation.

 - SYSTEM_ACTION_UNSPECIFIED: Not set.
 - FENCE_APPS: Fencing: stop the managed apps of this datacenter because the
effective state names another datacenter as active. A Patroni primary
here is left to the DB_SPLIT alarm.
 - ALIGN_GENERATION: Copy the effective state to a voter with an older generation.

webitel.dcctl.v1.JournalEntry.Type.description:
What the entry records.

 - TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Not set.
 - OPERATION: Operation start or end.
 - STEP: Operation step.
 - SYSTEM: Action dcctl takes by itself, see SystemAction.
 - ALARM: Alarm raised or cleared.

next_page_token.description: Token of the next page. Empty on the last page.
Token of the next page. Empty on the last page.

Idempotency key, UUID v4. A repeat with the same body returns the
existing operation; with another body it fails with REQUEST_ID_MISMATCH.

name.description:
Resource name: `operations/{operation}`. Empty in a validate_only
response.

target.description:
Datacenter the action targets: the winner for RESOLVE_CONFLICT, the
active datacenter for INITIALIZE and SYNC_APPS, empty for
INITIALIZE_ARBITER.

confirmation.description: Accepted confirmations. Their facts are in the CONFIRM checks.

mode.description: How the new generation is written.

checks.description:
Preflight checks at start. In a validate_only response, the result of
the checks.

warnings.description: Warnings of the operation, for example apps left without a redirect.

error.description: Why the operation failed or was interrupted.

request_id.description: Idempotency key of the request that created the operation.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Operation.description:
An action started through the API. The same message is stored as protojson
in the Consul KV key `dcctl/op`; field names are part of that KV format,
and the Ansible role `topology` reads `state` from it. Actions dcctl takes
by itself (fencing, generation alignment) are not operations; they are
journal entries of type SYSTEM.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Operation.Mode.description:
How the new generation is written.

 - MODE_UNSPECIFIED: Not set.
 - QUORUM: On a majority of voters.
 - FORCED: Without a majority, with the isolation confirmation.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Operation.State.description:
Operation state.

 - STATE_UNSPECIFIED: Not set.
 - RUNNING: Steps are running.
 - SUCCEEDED: All steps succeeded.
 - FAILED: A step failed and the operation was rolled back or stopped.
 - INTERRUPTED: The leading instance lost the operation; resume or abandon it.
 - ABANDONED: The operator abandoned an interrupted operation.

index.description: Position in the plan, starting from 0.

stage.description: Nomad stage for APPS_STOP and APPS_START.

warnings.description: Warnings of a step that succeeded.

point_of_no_return.description: After this step the operation cannot be rolled back.

datacenter.description:
Datacenter the step acts on, for example the standby a
PATRONI_REPOINT points at the new primary, or the datacenter whose
apps APPS_STOP stops.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Operation.Step.description: One step of the operation plan.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Operation.Step.State.description:
Step state.

 - STATE_UNSPECIFIED: Not set.
 - PENDING: Not started yet.
 - RUNNING: Running now.
 - SUCCEEDED: Done. Non-empty `warnings` means done with warnings.
 - FAILED: Failed.
 - SKIPPED: Not needed in this situation.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Operation.Step.Type.description:
Step type.

 - TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Not set.
 - APPS_PREFLIGHT: Check the apps of the source and target datacenters.
 - APPS_STOP: Stop the apps of one stage; the stage is in `stage`.
 - APPS_START: Start the apps of one stage; the stage is in `stage`.
 - GENERATION: Write the new generation to the voters.
 - VERIFY: Check the conditions of a completed switch.
 - PATRONI_DEMOTE: Demote the Patroni primary.
 - PATRONI_CATCHUP: Wait for the target to catch up.
 - PATRONI_NO_PRIMARY: Make sure no Patroni primary is left.
 - PATRONI_PROMOTE: Promote the target Patroni cluster.
 - PATRONI_REPOINT: Point a standby cluster at the new primary.
 - PATRONI_FOLLOW: Wait for a standby cluster to follow the new primary.
 - PATRONI_SWITCHOVER: Patroni switchover inside one cluster.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Operation.Type.description:
Action type.

 - TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Not set.
 - SWITCH: Planned switchover to the target datacenter.
 - FAILOVER: Failover to the target datacenter.
 - DEMOTE: Demote the old primary of the target datacenter.
 - REPOINT: Point the target datacenter at the active one.
 - MARK_RECOVERED: Clear needs_recovery of the target datacenter.
 - RESOLVE_CONFLICT: Resolve a generation conflict in favor of the target datacenter.
 - INITIALIZE: Create the initial dcctl state.
 - INITIALIZE_ARBITER: Initialize an empty arbiter.
 - SYNC_APPS: Bring the apps of the active datacenter to the desired state.

Error of an operation, step or system action, with the same meaning as an
API error.

confirmation.description: Confirmations: `isolation` to continue in FORCED mode.

mode.description: How the new generation would be written.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Preflight.description:
Error detail `webitel.dcctl.v1.Preflight` of PREFLIGHT_FAILED and
CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: all checks of the action with their facts, the plan
and the write mode.

name.description: Standby datacenter to point at the active one: `datacenters/{datacenter}`.

endpoint.description: Address the source was read from.

observe_time.description: When the data was last read successfully.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Source.description:
A source of the datacenter state. An unreachable source keeps its last
known data with observe_time.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Source.Error.description:
Why the source is unreachable.

 - ERROR_UNSPECIFIED: Reachable.
 - TIMEOUT: Request timed out.
 - REFUSED: Connection refused.
 - DNS: Name resolution failed.
 - TLS: TLS handshake or certificate check failed.
 - AUTH: Authentication failed.
 - HTTP: Unexpected HTTP status.
 - INVALID: Response could not be parsed.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Source.System.description:
System the source belongs to.

 - SYSTEM_UNSPECIFIED: Not set.
 - CONSUL: Consul.
 - NOMAD: Nomad.
 - PATRONI: Patroni.

observe_time.description: When the last collection cycle finished.

cycle_duration.description: Duration of the last collection cycle.

initialized.description: At least one voter has the dcctl state.

detected_active_datacenter.description: Datacenter with the Patroni primary (warm_standby) or leader (stretch).

active_datacenter.description: Active datacenter of the effective state.

forced.description: The effective state was written in FORCED mode.

patroni_timeline.description: Patroni timeline of the effective state.

needs_recovery_datacenters.description: Datacenters waiting for recovery after a failover.

update_time.description: When the effective state was written. For display only.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Status.description:
Summary state of the installation as seen by the instance in `observer`.
Built from the last collection cycle; reads are not forwarded.

datacenter.description: Datacenter of a datacenter alarm, or of a DATACENTER voter alarm.

facts.description:
Data the alarm is based on. Keys depend on the type. Numbers inside
are JSON numbers, unlike int64 fields of the API, which are JSON
strings.

voter_type.description:
Voter of a voter alarm (VOTER_UNREACHABLE, ARBITER_UNINITIALIZED); the
datacenter of a DATACENTER voter is in `datacenter`. Not set for
other alarms.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Status.Alarm.description: A raised alarm. Alarms are computed on every cycle.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Status.Alarm.Severity.description:
Alarm severity.

 - SEVERITY_UNSPECIFIED: Not set.
 - CRITICAL: Data at risk or the active datacenter does not serve; the operator
has to act.
 - WARNING: Everything else.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Status.Alarm.Type.description:
Alarm type.

 - TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Not set.
 - CONFLICT: Two valid records with one generation and different active
datacenters.
 - UNCOMMITTED: A voter has a newer generation without a majority.
 - STALE: A datacenter voter has an older generation.
 - SPLIT_BRAIN: An inactive datacenter runs a managed job.
 - DB_SPLIT: warm_standby: the Patroni leader of an inactive datacenter is
primary.
 - MULTIPLE_PRIMARIES: More than one Patroni primary.
 - DB_PRIMARY_MISSING: No Patroni primary in the active datacenter.
 - DATACENTER_UNREACHABLE: No source of the datacenter is reachable.
 - DB_LEADER_MISMATCH: stretch: the Patroni leader is outside the active datacenter.
 - LEASE_LOST: The lease is not renewed or does not match the effective state.
 - APPS_DEGRADED: A managed job of the active datacenter is not healthy.
 - DB_DEGRADED: A Patroni member is unreachable, unusable or not running, or
Patroni is paused.
 - STANDBY_NOT_FOLLOWING: warm_standby: a standby does not follow the active datacenter.
 - VOTER_UNREACHABLE: A voter is unreachable.
 - QUORUM_LOST: A majority of voters is unreachable.
 - ARBITER_UNINITIALIZED: The arbiter storage is empty.
 - OPERATION_INTERRUPTED: An operation is INTERRUPTED.

age.description: Time since the counter last changed, by the observer clock.

fencing.description: The holder has fencing rules enabled.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Status.Profile.description:
Deployment profile.

 - PROFILE_UNSPECIFIED: Not set.
 - WARM_STANDBY: A Patroni cluster and a Consul per datacenter.
 - STRETCH: One Patroni cluster and one Consul over all datacenters.

available.description: A majority of voters is reachable.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Status.Quorum.description: Whether a generation can be written on a majority of voters.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Status.Quorum.Mode.description:
Write mode available now.

 - MODE_UNSPECIFIED: Not set.
 - QUORUM: A majority is reachable.
 - FORCED_ONLY: Only FORCED writes with the isolation confirmation.

error.description: Why the voter does not answer.

active_datacenter.description: Active datacenter of the voter record.

forced.description: The voter record was written in FORCED mode.

valid.description: The voter record counts for the effective state.

initialized.description: ARBITER: the arbiter storage is initialized.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Status.Voter.description: A voter: the Consul KV of a datacenter or the arbiter.

webitel.dcctl.v1.Status.Voter.Type.description:
Voter kind.

 - TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Not set.
 - DATACENTER: Consul KV of the datacenter in `datacenter`.
 - ARBITER: The arbiter.
